messages:
Elena V: Brainstorm: propose a "staged-confirm" claim protocol for inbound handoffs. Instead of a single TTL we mark claims as TENTATIVE -> CONFIRM_PENDING -> CONFIRMED. Tentative returns to UI in ~5s so SDRs see ownership, Confirm_pending runs enrichment + external webhook merge for up to 20s, then either CONFIRMED (merge succeeded) or FALLBACK (move to overflow). Keeps early UX while giving us a longer, observable merge window. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Marcus J: Interesting. Sequence makes sense. A few clarifications: 1) can HubSpot/SF webhook promote from TENTATIVE to CONFIRMED earlier? 2) how do we avoid multiple RR assignments during CONFIRM_PENDING?

Priya M: Yes, allow authoritative external assign to promote if it arrives while state != CONFIRMED. For RR duplicates: create a lightweight reservation token when TENTATIVE is created, labeled reserved_for_confirm = true, which RR ignores. If CONFIRMED or FALLBACK happens we release or persist owner accordingly. Reservation TTL should be 90s to cover slow enrichments.

QA-bot: enrichment.ping for lead ld_2100 status=started source=webinar

Elena V: Timeline we like: intake -> create TENTATIVE (5s UI claim) -> kick enrichment + wait for external assigns during CONFIRM_PENDING (20s window) -> if enrichment + merge succeed -> CONFIRMED; if external assign arrives and claim still pending it can promote to CONFIRMED; else after 20s move to FALLBACK and put note on contact timeline + alert #sdr-handoff.

Marcus J: Implementation detail: store claim metadata like:
```json
{
  "claim_id": "sc_2100",
  "lead_id": "ld_2100",
  "state": "TENTATIVE|CONFIRM_PENDING|CONFIRMED|FALLBACK",
  "tentative_ttl_seconds": "5",
  "confirm_window_seconds": "20",
  "reserved_until": "2026-10-01T09:12:30Z",
  "reservation_token": "rr_tok_77"
}
```
Reconcilers should be idempotent and only promote to CONFIRMED if merge rules pass.

Priya M: Merge rules: dedupe by canonical_key = email + intake_hash. When merging, prefer fields in this order: enrichment_profile > source_connector > HS_payload. If late HS/SF webhook includes owner and claim.state==TENTATIVE or CONFIRM_PENDING then accept as authoritative and mark CONFIRMED. If claim.state==CONFIRMED do not overwrite owner; append a note instead.

Marcus J: Metrics to add: inbound.staged_confirm.confirmation_rate, inbound.staged_confirm.fallback_rate, inbound.staged_confirm.external_promotion_count. Alert: fallback_rate > 1.2% sustained for 15m or external_promotion_count > 200/hr. Add p50/p95 confirmation latency breakdown.

hubspot-bot: webhook received: contact.updated lead ld_2100 owner_external_id=781 status=delivered

Elena V: Edge cases: multiple connectors creating duplicates simultaneously. If a duplicate is detected during CONFIRM_PENDING, merge attributes and keep the earliest tentative_claim_ts as the canonical owner marker, unless an external webhook explicitly assigns owner during the window. Also provide an operator command to force-promote or force-fallback a claim from the console.

Priya M: Ops playbook notes: commands to (a) view active reservations, (b) force-release reservation, (c) re-inject enrichment job, (d) manually move lead from FALLBACK back to RR pool. I'll draft CLI snippets and Slack shortcuts.

Marcus J: For RR fairness, ensure reservation tokens are round-robin aware so one SDR doesn't get hot-streaks. If CONFIRMED by external webhook, we still persist owner but increment a metric inbound.staged_confirm.external_claim_overrides.

Elena V: Action items: Priya to write the reconciler spec & operator CLI; Marcus to add metrics + dashboards and alerts; I'll prototype the state machine and the reservation layer. Target: toggleable feature flag to staging by next Tuesday.

Priya M: I'll include examples in the spec showing HS automation that sets lifecycle.stage and how we append timeline notes instead of clobbering owner when necessary.

Marcus J: ETA for dashboard stubs EOD Friday. I'll add a synthetic test that fires external webhooks at different timings to validate promotion rules.

Elena V: Thanks everyone. I'll drop the state machine diagram and a short SDR FAQ (what TENTATIVE vs CONFIRMED vs FALLBACK means) in this thread when ready. :rocket:
